# Manuscript plots 

## Figure 1
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(broom)
library(patchwork)
library(lme4)
library(sjPlot)
})
# =============================================================================
# MANUSCRIPT FIGURES: 3-Panel Set for Clock Design Benchmarking
# Figure 1: Design space & performance
# Figure 2: CpG count scaling  
# Figure 3: Global design effects
# =============================================================================
metrics_scores <- metrics_data_validation %>%
  group_by(cpg_grouping, model, organ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Rescale MAE (invert so that lower MAE → higher score)
    mae_score = scales::rescale(-mae),

    # Rescale R² to 0–1, where higher values → higher score
    r2_score = scales::rescale(r_squared_value)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    # Composite continuous performance metric:
    # Higher values represent better-performing clocks
    performance_score = mae_score + r2_score,

    # Convert design factors to categorical variables
    cpg_grouping = factor(cpg_grouping),
    tile_methode = factor(tile_methode),
    model = factor(model),
    organ = factor(organ),
    rsq_threshold = factor(rsq_threshold),
    filter = factor(filter),

    # Scale numeric hyperparameters (important for mixed-model stability)
    epse_scaled = scale(epse)
  )
# --- PREP: Consistent factor levels ---
Multi_organ <- sort(unique(metrics_scores$organ))
all_groupings <- sort(unique(metrics_scores$cpg_grouping))
all_models <- sort(unique(metrics_scores$model))

# =============================================================================
# FIGURE 1: Design Space & Performance
# =============================================================================

# 1A: Design space - model counts by organ × cpg_grouping
design_space <- metrics_data_validation %>%
  count(organ, cpg_grouping) %>%
  mutate(
    organ = factor(organ, levels = Multi_organ),
    cpg_grouping = factor(cpg_grouping, levels = all_groupings)
  )

p1a <- ggplot(design_space, aes(x = cpg_grouping, y = organ, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), color = "white", fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("#56B4E9", "white", "#D55E00"),
    values = scales::rescale(c(0, 0.5, 1)),
    name = "# Models"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "",
    title = "A. Number of models"
  ) +
theme_classic2(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text    = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text   = element_text(face = "bold"),   # facet labels
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
# 1B : Performance by cpg_grouping
signif_data <- get_signif_per_group(
  df = metrics_scores,
  y_var = "performance_score",
  x_var = "cpg_grouping",
  group_var = "cpg_grouping"
)

p1b <-  ggplot(
  metrics_scores ,
  aes(
    y = performance_score,
    x = cpg_grouping,
    colour = factor(cpg_grouping),
    group = factor(cpg_grouping)
  )
) +
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_se,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.15,
    position = position_dodge(0.8)
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    size = 2,
    position = position_dodge(0.8)
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = master_pal) +
  labs(
    title = "B. Absolute Performance",
    x = "",
    y = "Performance Score",
    colour = ""
  ) +
  theme_classic2(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text    = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text   = element_text(face = "bold"),   # facet labels
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(face = "bold")
  )


# Add significance layers.
p1b <- p1b+ stat_pvalue_manual(
  signif_data,
  label = "label",
  tip.length = 0.0001,
  hide.ns = FALSE,
  size = 4
)
# 1B.1: Performance by cpg_grouping, faceted by organ
# Repeat significance definitions (kept separate for clarity).
  sig_data <- tibble::tribble(
    ~organ,        ~xmin, ~xmax, ~y_position, ~annotations,
    "Brain",         1,     3,      1.45,        "***",
    "Brain",         2,     3,      1.50,        "**",
    "Intestines",    1,     3,      1.21,        "***",
    "Multi_organ",    1,     3,      1.38,        "***"
  )

  p1b.1 <-  ggplot(
  metrics_scores ,
  aes(
    y = performance_score,
    x = cpg_grouping,
    colour = factor(cpg_grouping),
    group = interaction(organ, factor(cpg_grouping))
  )
) +
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_se,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.15,
    position = position_dodge(0.8)
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    size = 2,
    position = position_dodge(0.8)
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = master_pal) +
  labs(
    title = "B. Absolute Performance",
    x = "",
    y = "Performance Score",
    colour = ""
  ) +
theme_classic2(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text    = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text   = element_text(face = "bold"),   # facet labels
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(face = "bold")
  )+
    facet_nested_wrap(~ organ, ncol = 2)
  

# Add significance layers.
  p1b.1 <- p1b.1 +
  geom_segment(
    data = sig_data,
    aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax, y = y_position, yend = y_position),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.5,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = sig_data,
    aes(
      x = (xmin + xmax) / 2,
      y = y_position + 0.025,
      label = annotations
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 5
  )




fig1 <- (p1a | p1b) + 
  plot_annotation(title = "1. Design Space & Absolute Performance") 
print(fig1)
ggsave(paste0(output_directory,"/fig1_design_performance.png"), fig1, width = 16, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# =============================================================================
# FIGURE 2: CpG Count Scaling
# =============================================================================
merged_metrics_scores <- metrics_scores %>%
  left_join(
    cpg_data_validation_long %>% 
      dplyr::select(unique_model_id, num_selected_cpg, num_candidate_cpg,selected_cpgs, chr,start,end),
    by = "unique_model_id"
  )

# 2A: Forest plot of slopes per organ (performance ~ num_selected_cpg)

slopes_organ_sel  <- merged_metrics_scores %>%
    mutate(sel_cpg = num_selected_cpg) %>%
    group_by(organ) %>%
    do({
        dat <- .
        fit <- lmer(
            performance_score ~ sel_cpg + num_candidate_cpg +
                (1|selected_cpgs) + (1|chr),
            data = dat,
            REML = FALSE
        )
        broom.mixed::tidy(fit, effects = "fixed", conf.int = FALSE)
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(term == "sel_cpg") %>%
    mutate(
        p_value = 2 * pnorm(abs(statistic), lower.tail = FALSE),
        star = dplyr::case_when(
            p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
            p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
            p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
            TRUE ~ ""
        ),
        organ = factor(organ, levels = Multi_organ)
    )


p2a <-ggplot(slopes_organ_sel, aes(x = organ, y = estimate, colour = organ)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "grey70") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
                    ymax = estimate + 1.96 * std.error),
                width = 0.15) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(
    data = slopes_organ_sel,
    aes(
      x = organ,
      y = estimate + 2.2 * std.error,
      label = star
    ),
    colour = "black",
    size = 3,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Δ performance per additional selected CpG",
    colour = "",
    title = "C. Selected CpG scaling"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = master_pal) +
  theme_classic2(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text    = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text   = element_text(face = "bold"),   # facet labels
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1) 
  )

# 2B : 
slopes_organ_cand <- merged_metrics_scores  %>%
  mutate(log_sel_cpg = log10(num_candidate_cpg)) %>%
    group_by(organ) %>%
    do({
        dat <- .
        fit <- lmer(
            performance_score ~ log_sel_cpg + num_candidate_cpg +
                (1|selected_cpgs) + (1|chr),
            data = dat,
            REML = FALSE
        )
        broom.mixed::tidy(fit, effects = "fixed", conf.int = FALSE)
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(term == "log_sel_cpg") %>%
    mutate(
        p_value = 2 * pnorm(abs(statistic), lower.tail = FALSE),
        star = dplyr::case_when(
            p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
            p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
            p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
            TRUE ~ ""
        ),
        organ = factor(organ, levels = Multi_organ)
    )

p2b <- ggplot(slopes_organ_cand, aes(x = organ, y = estimate, colour = organ)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "grey70") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = estimate - 1.96 * std.error, ymax = estimate + 1.96 * std.error), width = 0.15) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(data = slopes_organ_cand,
            aes(x = organ, 
                y = estimate + 2.2 * std.error,  # above error bar
                label = star),
            colour = "black", size = 3,
            inherit.aes = FALSE)+
  labs(x = "", y = "Δ performance per additonal candidate CpGs", colour = "",title = "D. Candidate CpG scaling") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = master_pal) +
   theme_classic2(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text    = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text   = element_text(face = "bold"),   # facet labels
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1) 
  )


# 2C: Heatmap organ × cpg_grouping slopes
slopes_group_organ <- merged_metrics_scores  %>%
 mutate(sel_cpg = num_selected_cpg) %>%
    group_by(organ, cpg_grouping) %>%
    do({
        dat <- .
        fit <- lmer(
            performance_score ~ sel_cpg + num_candidate_cpg +
                (1|selected_cpgs) + (1|chr),
            data = dat,
            REML = FALSE
        )
        broom.mixed::tidy(fit, effects = "fixed", conf.int = FALSE)
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(term == "sel_cpg") %>%
    mutate(
        p_value = 2 * pnorm(abs(statistic), lower.tail = FALSE),
        star = dplyr::case_when(
            p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
            p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
            p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
            TRUE ~ ""
        ),
        organ = factor(organ, levels = Multi_organ)
    )
  

p2c <- ggplot(slopes_group_organ, aes(x = cpg_grouping, y = organ, fill = estimate)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = star), size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#56B4E9", mid = "white", high =  "#D55E00", midpoint = 0,
                       name = "CpG Slope") +
  labs(x = "Feature Selection", y = "", title = "E. Method × Organ") +
  theme_classic2(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text    = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text   = element_text(face = "bold"),   # facet labels
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)
  )

# 2D: Heatmap organ × model slopes
slopes_model_organ <- merged_metrics_scores  %>%
  mutate(sel_cpg = num_selected_cpg) %>%
    group_by(organ, model) %>%
    do({
        dat <- .
        fit <- lmer(
            performance_score ~ sel_cpg + num_candidate_cpg +
                (1|selected_cpgs) + (1|chr),
            data = dat,
            REML = FALSE
        )
        broom.mixed::tidy(fit, effects = "fixed", conf.int = FALSE)
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(term == "sel_cpg") %>%
    mutate(
        p_value = 2 * pnorm(abs(statistic), lower.tail = FALSE),
        star = dplyr::case_when(
            p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
            p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
            p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
            TRUE ~ ""
        ),
        organ = factor(organ, levels = Multi_organ))

p2d <- ggplot(slopes_model_organ, aes(x = model, y = organ, fill = estimate)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = star), size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#56B4E9", mid = "white", high =  "#D55E00", midpoint = 0,
                       name = "CpG Slope") +
  labs(x = "Model Family", y = "", title = "F. Model × Organ") +
  theme_classic2(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text    = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text   = element_text(face = "bold"),   # facet labels
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1)
  
  )

fig2 <- (((p2a+ guides(colour="none")| p2b )) |( p2c +  guides(fill="none")| p2d ))+
  plot_layout(widths  = c(0.6,0.6,1)) +
  plot_annotation(title = "2. Performance Scaling with CpG Count")
print(fig2)
ggsave(paste0(output_directory,"/fig2_cpg_scaling.png"), fig2, width = 16, height = 10, dpi = 300)

# =============================================================================
# FIGURE 3: Global Design Effects
# =============================================================================

# 3A: Mixed effects model coefficients
m <- lmer(performance_score ~ cpg_grouping + tile_methode + model + 
            rsq_threshold + filter + epse_scaled + (1 | organ), 
          data =metrics_scores )
summary(m)
Anova(m, type="III")
p3a <- plot_model(m, type = "est", show.values = TRUE, value.offset = 0.3,
                  title = "H. Fixed Effects: All Design Parameters") +
  scale_color_manual(values = okabe_ito) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text    = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text   = element_text(face = "bold"),   # facet labels
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(face = "bold") 
  )+
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# 3B: Best method per organ (bar chart)
best_per_organ <- metrics_scores  %>%
  group_by(organ, cpg_grouping) %>%
  summarise(median_perf = median(performance_score), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(organ) %>%
  slice_max(median_perf, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(organ = factor(organ, levels = Multi_organ))

p3b <- ggplot(best_per_organ, aes(x = organ, y = median_perf, fill = cpg_grouping)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_label(
    aes(label = round(median_perf, 2)),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    fill = "white",
    colour = "black",
    size = 3,
    label.size = 0.2,   # border thickness; set to 0 for no border
    label.r = unit(0.1, "lines")  # corner radius; adjust if needed
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Best Performance",
    fill = "Best Method",
    title = "G. Optimal Feature Selection per Organ"
  ) +
    theme_classic2(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text    = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text   = element_text(face = "bold"),   # facet labels
    plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(face = "bold")
  )+
  scale_fill_manual(values = master_pal)

fig3 <-   p3b | p3a + 
  plot_annotation(title = "3. Global Design Effects & Best Practices") & 
  theme(legend.position="bottom")
print(fig3)
ggsave(paste0(output_directory,"/fig3_global_effects.png"), fig3, width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300)

# =============================================================================
# GRAND MANUSCRIPT FIGURE (All 3 figures combined)
# =============================================================================
manuscript_all <- fig1 / fig2 / fig3 +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 0.8, 1))

print(manuscript_all)
ggsave("results/final_manuscript_figures/manuscript_complete_figure1.png", manuscript_all, width = 17, height = 20, dpi = 400)
```
